title: Register book-guard in the shared app-icon family
objective: The book-guard Flutter app (Android + web) ships an icon from the shared family, generated by the one shared generator, and the android_ui CLI test suite is hermetic with respect to the phone lease. Success: the registry tests pass at 100% coverage and the icon renders legibly at 48dp.
acceptance_criteria: open-book glyph stays inside SAFE_BOX with negative space >= MIN_NEGATIVE_SPACE
book_guard_app registered with the shared accent and generates Android assets
test_cli passes regardless of the host's phone lease state
verifier: pre-commit (pytest with coverage enforcement) + python3 -m python_pkg.app_icons preview
